'''Aratech Repulsor Company''', also known as '''Aratech Systems'''<ref name="Bounty">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|The Aratech Bounty}}</ref> was a manufacturer that started out before [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], and manufactured, among other things, sniper rifles and [[G0-T0 infrastructure planning system]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including the most infamous unit, known simply as [[G0-T0]] or "Goto". The company was often at odds with the larger [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], who they saw as conservative and immoral. When several of their G0-T0s rebelled against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[3946 BBY]], Aratech's deteriorating reputation amongst much of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] population nearly bankrupted itself. The company's second attempt at networked droids was the [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]]. Another failure, Aratech abandoned droid manufacturing and focused on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology.

As '''Aratech Repulsor Company''', it pledged its support to the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Their most noted product was the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]], which remained in service throughout the Clone Wars and the reign of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

During the Rise of the Empire era, '''Aratech Corporation''' sent support staff to various Imperial outposts and garrisons.

==History==
Aratech was formed prior to [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] as a weapons and droid manufacturers and during the [[Galactic War]], it announced a revolution in terms of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] technology and design.<ref name="Tomorrow">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Tomorrow's Tech Today}}</ref> At the same time, the [[Company/Legends|company]] offered a reward to any [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who could hack the prototype of their security system.<ref name="Bounty" />

The company eventually became the Aratech Repulsor Company and manufactured the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="EVV" />

Staff members from the Aratech Corporation gave advanced briefings and training to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|biker scout]] personnel.<ref name="Card-CCG-Aratech Corporation">''{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Aratech Corporation}}''</ref>
